Strategy: Wide absolute dead-zone avoidance. Exact fits score highest; post-placement residuals of 1–20 score far below looser fits, since such gaps likely cannot hold items; larger residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit would leave a residual of 1–20, then a looser bin preserves a usable gap. It may help by cutting waste more aggressively, but may fail if future items are small enough to use those gaps.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-100.0 + (r - item) if r - item <= 20 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Wide absolute dead-zone avoidance: residual 1-20 penalized, exact fit highest, else Best Fit.
